audit_summary.summary: Four GTM-NAME-001 naming findings across tag, trigger, variable and folder. Two low-risk name-only draft edits applied; variable and folder renames withheld for manual review.

findings.title: Vague tag name: tag 1
findings.description: [GTM-NAME-001; NAME-TAG-001] Name obscures platform, tag type, and event; the proposed GA4 event naming is supported by the exported tag type and eventName.

evidence.observation: Tag 101 measurementId='{{id}}', which resolves by name to variable 301.

recommended_actions: Use 'GA4 - Event - lead_submit' as a draft name-only edit; preserve tag ID, payload and trigger.

findings.title: Vague trigger name: all
findings.description: [GTM-NAME-001; NAME-TRIGGER-001] Name omits trigger type and apparent page scope; all-pages scope is inferred from exported configuration, not live behavior.

evidence.observation: No filter or condition fields are present on trigger 201; tag 101 references firingTriggerId '201'.

recommended_actions: Use 'PV - All Pages' as a draft name-only edit; confirm actual trigger scope in GTM Preview.

findings.title: Vague variable name: id
findings.description: [GTM-NAME-001; NAME-VARIABLE-001] The generic name hides its likely GA4 measurement-ID purpose. Renaming it alone would break the tag's name-based reference.

evidence.observation: Tag 101 parameter measurementId='{{id}}' refers to this variable by its name.

recommended_actions: Manually review a coordinated rename to 'CONST - GA4 Measurement ID' and corresponding tag token replacement, without modifying the constant value.

findings.title: Vague folder name: misc
findings.description: [GTM-NAME-001; NAME-FOLDER-001] Folder has an ambiguous grouping purpose. 'GA4 - Lead Measurement' is only a candidate inferred from its contents.

evidence.observation: Tag 101 and variable 301 both have parentFolderId='401'; no other objects refer to this folder.

recommended_actions: Confirm the business grouping before renaming; candidate 'GA4 - Lead Measurement' is not applied.

manual_review_items.reason: Confirm trigger 201 actually has all-pages scope before accepting CH-002.
Variable 301 is referenced by tag token {{id}}; a variable rename would require coordinated token updates and external-reference review.
Folder 401 naming intent is inferred from contents; confirm grouping with owner before renaming.
Review CH-001 and CH-002 and conduct GTM Preview QA before any import or production activity.

assumptions: 'gaawe' and eventName 'lead_submit' indicate a GA4 event tag; export evidence only.
Trigger PAGEVIEW without exported filters appears to be all-pages, but live behavior is not verified.
No client profile or client-specific naming overrides were supplied.
External documents, recipes or integrations that may reference entity names are not available.
